| description = Named wurm for bard and magician epics. Placeholder is a high level wurm that cons blue at 60. It will roam some time after spawning, but makes its way back to the spawn spot (-1089, -3781) and stands. There are other blue-con-at-60 wurms that roam nearby, but only one will stop wandering at the spawn point. 6:40 respawn on PH and/or named. Averaged seemed to be around 10-15 PHs per named. Either [[Nezekezena]] or [[Phurzikon]] can spawn at the spawn point.

==== Soloing as a Mage ====
Phurzikon ''can'' be soloed by a Magician (54), but it is very challenging.  You have to pull him somewhere with less wandering mobs, like the wall East of his spawn point. Engage him with a pet, pull to wall, while your pet fights him back up far enough that you have time to summon a new pet, and when pet is <6% start summoning a new one.

Repeat this process until Phurzikon is getting close to 20% health where he will begin to gate, then relocate to his spawn point.  Have pet engage while you nuke him down using [[Shock of Swords]] (as he's basically fire immune).  Because you will likely get wandering mobs added, have him gate at the wrong time, etc. you should expect to need to make several attempts; bringing a stunner or mana drainer is recommended.
